title: Install pulse summary and open actions 2026-06-25
content:
Context and purpose:
This is a compact operational summary from the Private Deployments squad summarizing field installs, recurring customer blockers, and the open action list coming out of the 2026-06-25 standup/ops sync. The goal is to give on-call engineers and SEs a single-view of recurring root causes, mitigation status, and the next owners for each open item.

Summary highlights (last 7 days):
- Completed: two VPC installations (Customer Rho, Customer Linden) finished smoke tests and canary traffic routing on dedicated hosts. Both passed perf baseline but Rho showed intermittent connection drops during large KV cache priming.
- In progress: one on-prem edge deployment (Customer Halden) is mid-install; blocked by storage IO anomalies on their SAN.
- Regression observed: a rolling regression in the install agent (deploy-agent v0.13.1 -> v0.14.0) caused misreports of GPU memory on hosts with mixed legacy drivers; affects preflight checks and can cause false install aborts.
- Escalations: two active escalations — (1) Customer Linden: intermittent TLS renegotiation failures between deployment control plane and customer peered VPC; (2) Customer Halden: vendor storage firmware mismatches causing degraded read latency.

Standup notes (2026-06-25 09:30 PT):
Participants: Aisha (owner), Marco (SRE lead), Tanya (solutions eng), Owen (install eng), Priya (field PM), Sam (customer Linden SE, joined), R&D on-call (async)

Round-robin updates:
- Marco: Observability — added a temporary alert to detect sudden drops in kv_cache_fill_rate; saw 3 incidents across Rho and Linden in past 48 hours. Tracing shows bursty client traffic plus cache priming correlates with connection resets.
- Tanya: Linden customer reported errors visible in envoy: TLS handshake timeouts at ~1.2% of requests during peak. Working with Linden network team to capture PCAPs and confirm MTU/fragmentation.
- Owen: Install agent regression — root cause narrowed to a metrics parsing change in v0.14.0 where driver reports with nonstandard suffixes (e.g., "A100-40GB:revX") fail the integer parse. Patch PR opened, tests added, and hotfix build started.
- Priya: Halden storage — vendor provided a firmware downgrade recommendation; running canary verify this afternoon. If results fail, we will swap to ephemeral NVMe for the data tier as a stopgap.

Reproduced issues and diagnostics so far:
- KV cache priming + concurrent high-throughput (50k+ tokens/min) causes upstream control channel to spike CPU on the control-plane side for deployments without prefix caching configured. Diagnosed via trace sampling and flamegraphs; mitigated by enabling prefix-based prefetch on affected model routes.
- Agent misreporting: reproduce locally by mocking nvidia-smi output with unexpected suffix text; test added to deploy-agent unit suite.

Action items (owner — eta — notes):
- OWEN — merge hotfix for deploy-agent parsing (PR #89) — ETA: 2026-06-25 EOD — unblock installs for customers with legacy drivers.
- MARCO/TANYA — Linden TLS packet capture and MTU validation — ETA: 2026-06-26 AM — coordinate with Linden network ops, join call 2026-06-25 15:00 PT.
- PRIYA — coordinate Halden fallback plan: NVMe swap and data validation plan — ETA: 2026-06-26 — need procurement sign-off; determine downtime window.
- AISHA — rollout temporary alert rule to detect kv_cache_fill_rate drops and trigger autoscaler guardrail — ETA: 2026-06-25 noon — will keep rule at aggressive threshold for 48 hours.
- MARCO — add a short-run chaos test to CI that simulates bursty token traffic to validate control-plane CPU behavior — ETA: 2026-07-02 — will prototype as a daily smoke test.

Risk posture and customer impact:
- Customer Linden: medium risk (intermittent, visible errors but not total outage); SE engaged and workaround (retry backoff + smaller MTU) in testing.
- Customer Rho: low-to-medium risk (nonblocking drops during warm-up); resolved by enabling prefix caching on the model route in staging and planning a targeted config push in production off peak.
- Customer Halden: high risk for initial launch if vendor firmware path fails; fallback path required to avoid extended downtime.

Notes on communication and runbook updates:
- Runbook: "Private install — TLS negotiation failures" needs a short how-to for capturing PCAPs behind customer firewall and an example set of envoy filters to add for MTU workarounds. Priya to draft and push to Confluence pageId=547821.
- SE comms: Tanya to own an interim customer-facing note to Linden summarizing temporary mitigations and ETA; please use "Linden-TLS-Interim-2026-06-25" subject.

Decisions made during sync:
- We will not roll back deploy-agent to v0.13.x globally; instead apply a targeted hotfix and add the parsing test to CI. Rationale: rollback would remove other fixes; hotfix minimal risk.
- For Halden, proceed with firmware downgrade test first; if vendor denies downgrade, execute NVMe fallback plan with a pre-notified maintenance window.

Open questions (need answers before next sync):
- Can Linden provide a packet capture and flow logs for the failing period (Tanya asking for capture from 2026-06-24 18:30-19:00 PT)?
- Does Halden have spare NVMe capacity on any node for quick fallback or will procurement be required? (Priya to confirm)
- Should we add an automatic short-circuit rule in the control-plane to pause prefix prefetch when kv_cache_fill_rate drops to avoid cascading CPU load? (Marco to prototype)

Appendix: quick commands / diagnostics collected
- Example: collect agent debug bundle: curl -fsSL https://deploy-agent.local/debug | tar -xz -C /tmp && grep -i "nvidia" /tmp/debug/*.log
- Example: enable verbose envoy logs temporarily: kubectl -n deploy apply -f envoy-verbose-patch.yaml && kubectl rollout restart daemonset/envoy
- Trace link examples: sampling traces pinned in Sentry/Zipkin under project "private-deploy" for incident IDs 2026-06-24-01 and 2026-06-24-02.

Quick timeline for next 48 hours:
- 2026-06-25 EOD: merge/ship agent hotfix (Owen).
- 2026-06-26 AM: Linden network call and packet capture validation (Tanya + Marco).
- 2026-06-26 EOD: Halden firmware canary result and fallback decision (Priya).
- 2026-06-27 AM: follow-up sync notes posted and runbook drafts updated (Aisha).

If you have additional logs or want to join the postmortem thread, drop notes on the Slack thread linked above or ping the private-deployments channel.

— Aisha Kapoor, eng-private-deployments
